name: Band Kneeling Hip Thrust
steps: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and a loop band just above them.
Press gently outward against the band and fold at the hips to sit back toward your heels.
Drive your hips forward until your torso and thighs line up over your knees.
Bend at the hips to return while keeping the band taut.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your pelvis at the top instead of arching your lower back.
Keep your knees over the same spots on the floor as your hips move.
